title: Keep the task-sync bootstrap Git-count test independent of a fixed total
outcome: Keep the task-sync bootstrap Git-count test independent of a fixed total
acceptance: The parentless rebuild regression compares complete Git command maps at 200 and 2,000 tasks and asserts one scoped status and one diff-tree. A legitimate reduction in Git launches can pass without updating an absolute expected total. The test still checks exact commit adoption, zero task reads and zero task writes.
